rawContent: UK Twitter: What are some genuinely helpful resources for victims of either workplace sexual harassment/assault or workplace bullying? (It's not me, I'm just wondering who has found good support & from which organisations) #SpeakUp #workplacesafety #itsnotok #activism #MeToo

@BonnyTurner1212 @emilyinpublic ... & the efforts of @centreWJ @EVAWuk @Imkaan @RapeCrisisEandW they've eked an apology from the UK gov for failing rape victims. Now, let's hope more is done to fix a weak criminal justice system & hold rapists accountable for the many lives they damage #RapeJusticeNow #MeToo
